posts.title: An AI Analyst That Shows Its Work
posts.description: A natural-language analyst that connects evidence across the data landscape, routes questions to governed models, applies the required filters, runs queries under your identity, and shows its work. The LLM handles the conversation; governed models and model-specific guidance determine how each question is answered.
